title: Waymo Won The Robotaxi War. Cruise Didn't.
hook: One shut down. One took over.
source: Source: Waymo weekly paid-ride disclosures as reported by TechCrunch, CNBC, Forbes and Axios (2021-2026); Cruise weekly ride volume approximated from company and media reporting prior to its October 2023 California permit suspension and General Motors' December 2024 shutdown of the robotaxi program. Figures approximate.
